PublicPolicySection.title: A public policy instrument
PublicPolicySection.text: SEDES is the integrated information system provided for in Law No. 13,153/2015, which establishes the National Policy to Combat Desertification and Mitigate the Effects of Drought. It brings together official data on drought, vegetation cover, land degradation and socioeconomic conditions for the entire national territory and supports living with drought, reducing vulnerabilities and preventing land degradation, broadening society's access to knowledge about the territory.
